shared_candidate_same_seed: one physical start, all method credits explicitly dependent; unspent starts not replaced
initial_coverage: four observed development points, no convex-hull or full initial-set guarantee
derivative_guard: both perturbations must have identical complete source branch signature, else derivative unavailable and axis fixed
linearization_error_rule: report relative prediction error at fixed forward holdout, never tune/rerank after physical validation
objective: max(peak tilt/45, all-prefix LP D/1m, all-prefix COM D/1m) over A through B-resume+2s; publish components, conditional center only
ensemble_aggregation: arithmetic mean of four source-initial conditional objectives, every initial retained
random: Random(seed) uniform pool candidate; seed is block identity
continuous: choose anchor side using Random(seed+1); one same-branch gradient step to registered pool corner maximizing linear objective within trust rectangle; invalid derivative axis fixed at origin
branch: same finite gradient construction separately in both release cells; maximize piecewise objective including cell intercept jump
order: Random(seed+2) shuffle method order within seed; merge duplicate candidate/seed at first occurrence
safety: original task/safety thresholds and policy unchanged; scientific failure retained
failure_categories: physical/identity/time/critical observation fault pauses dependents; pure analysis fixes versioned; resource loss preserves prefix; no replacements
all_costs: all forecasts, gradients, validation pool, theory, development, errors, shared anchors, SITL and review separately charged; 2400 search CPU cap includes all jobs
